requirements.requirement: The runtime bundle is rebased to the exact commit that passed Core Gate C4 before any runtime edit.
requirements.acceptance: Handoff report records core evidence, current HEAD/delta, dirty state, and invalidated source references.

requirements.requirement: Every process launch, terminal, runtime node, Manager supervisor, MCP, external tool, plugin host tool, and process-driver surface is inventoried.
requirements.acceptance: No unclassified P0/P1 runtime surface remains at gate R0.

requirements.requirement: Ownership between MAF execution primitives, Workbench presentation, Manager supervision, Plugins, and Processes domain semantics is approved before refactoring.
requirements.acceptance: Architecture map has one authoritative owner for plan, execution, lifecycle, recovery, capability, receipt, and domain failure semantics.

requirements.requirement: The bundle split decision is revisited using measured file/project/dependency scope.
requirements.acceptance: If split triggers are met, child bundles are generated before implementation; no miscellaneous overflow is accepted.

requirements.requirement: Direct execution uses a typed immutable plan containing executable identity, argv, working directory, environment names/values, timeout, output limits, side effects, and boundary metadata.
requirements.acceptance: No ordinary .NET/Docker/Python/Node command is reconstructed from display text or passed through a shell.

requirements.requirement: One tested low-level process execution primitive is authoritative for workspace commands, external tools, and injected plugin runtimes unless a documented boundary requires a wrapper.
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate local runners do not diverge in cancellation, kill, output, environment, or receipt behavior.

requirements.requirement: Executable resolution is deterministic, capability-owned, and OS-correct.
requirements.acceptance: Windows PATHEXT behavior, Unix execute bits/shebang, explicit paths, PATH order, case rules, and missing/ambiguous candidates have tests.

requirements.requirement: Environment inheritance preserves host key semantics and uses safe common plus OS/tool-specific allowlists.
requirements.acceptance: Unix case-distinct variables remain distinct; secret values are opt-in bindings and only names enter receipts.

requirements.requirement: Cancellation and timeout terminate the owned process tree or report a bounded residual-process failure.
requirements.acceptance: Windows/Linux/macOS tests cover grandchildren, TERM/grace/KILL where implemented, output drain, races, and cancellation source.

requirements.requirement: Process host, registry, and workspace runtime services have one explicit owner and disposal lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance: No plugin/workspace factory constructs an untracked parallel host; disposal and kept-alive leases are proven.

requirements.requirement: Execution receipts are deterministic, redact sensitive output, preserve logical paths, and record truthful isolation/capability data.
requirements.acceptance: Sentinel-secret and cross-OS golden receipt tests pass.

requirements.requirement: Native adapters are added only after characterization proves .NET Process APIs insufficient.
requirements.acceptance: Decision records capture the failing behavior and scope any Windows Job Object or Unix process-group adapter.

requirements.requirement: ProjectStructure runtime metadata compiles to a shell-neutral typed execution plan.
requirements.acceptance: Plan compilation is pure/testable and separate from direct execution, terminal presentation, and UI display.

requirements.requirement: PowerShell, POSIX shell, and other script languages are explicit script modes with separate policy and executable dependency.
requirements.acceptance: Raw scripts never become an implicit fallback for ordinary commands.

requirements.requirement: Python virtual environments resolve their interpreter/tool paths by OS and execute directly without requiring activation.
requirements.acceptance: Windows Scripts and Unix bin layouts are tested; Conda behavior is capability-gated.

requirements.requirement: Opening an interactive terminal is optional presentation, not the execution authority.
requirements.acceptance: Headless mode executes directly or reports the terminal-only feature unavailable without blocking startup.

requirements.requirement: Elevation is a separate optional capability and is unavailable by default on Linux/macOS.
requirements.acceptance: No automatic sudo, pkexec, osascript, or password prompt is introduced; Windows runas remains explicitly governed.

requirements.requirement: Legacy PowerShell/cmd command metadata has a bounded compatibility/migration path into typed runtime-node fields.
requirements.acceptance: Migration does not attempt to safely parse arbitrary dynamic shell code; unresolved nodes require operator repair.

requirements.requirement: Workbench UI labels and actions reflect Run, Open terminal, Open file, and Elevated launch capabilities rather than PowerShell-centric assumptions.
requirements.acceptance: Playwright snapshots cover available, unavailable, dependency-missing, headless, and foreign-path states.

requirements.requirement: Runtime node path authority uses the core logical/physical path contracts and cannot escape approved roots.
requirements.acceptance: Agent-selected and operator-selected modes retain their distinct authority rules.

requirements.requirement: Manager persists identity for processes it launches and uses that registry as primary ownership truth.
requirements.acceptance: PID, start identity, executable, argv hash, workspace, user/owner, parent/lease, and lifecycle state are captured without secrets.

requirements.requirement: Windows WMI recovery discovery is isolated behind a Windows leaf adapter.
requirements.acceptance: Neutral Manager code compiles/runs without directly calling System.Management.

requirements.requirement: Linux recovery discovery uses a bounded /proc or equivalent adapter and validates ownership before action.
requirements.acceptance: Missing permissions, exited processes, PID reuse, and unreadable command lines fail safely.

requirements.requirement: macOS recovery discovery uses a proven bounded adapter and validates ownership before action.
requirements.acceptance: The implementation does not parse locale-dependent human output without strict fixtures and fallback behavior.

requirements.requirement: Manager never terminates a process using name-only or path-substring evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Ambiguous or incomplete identity produces a diagnostic/manual cleanup state.

requirements.requirement: Watch/Tailwind supervisors share tested process lifecycle and watcher-rescan primitives without merging domain responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance: Restart/backoff, duplicate start, cancellation, and output-file convergence are tested on all target OSes.

requirements.requirement: Manager path collections and comparisons use core logical/physical semantics rather than global OrdinalIgnoreCase.
requirements.acceptance: Case-collision fixtures pass on Linux and configured macOS filesystems.

requirements.requirement: Local MCP command authorization validates the resolved executable identity using one capability-owned policy.
requirements.acceptance: Suffix, PATH, explicit path, symlink, and case tests pass on Windows/Linux/macOS.

requirements.requirement: Local stdio MCP launch reuses authoritative process/environment semantics and has bounded startup/shutdown ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Cancellation leaves no server process and diagnostics expose no secret values.

requirements.requirement: Playwright MCP is installed/resolved from a controlled versioned application tool root.
requirements.acceptance: Global npx cache scanning is removed from production selection or explicitly limited to a non-authoritative diagnostic path.

requirements.requirement: MCP environment secret bindings resolve at invocation time through the secret runtime boundary.
requirements.acceptance: Persisted descriptors contain references/names, not secret values; receipts contain approved names only.

requirements.requirement: MCP setup validation reports command, runtime, package, working-directory, secret-binding, and platform capability failures separately.
requirements.acceptance: Repair hints are deterministic and tested.

requirements.requirement: External process tools share or wrap the authoritative process primitive and do not implement a divergent local runner.
requirements.acceptance: Timeout, output limit, cancellation, and tree-kill tests are common.

requirements.requirement: External tool stdout/stderr diagnostics are bounded and redacted before entering exceptions, receipts, agent context, or CI logs.
requirements.acceptance: Sentinel-secret tests cover JSON parse and non-zero-exit paths.

requirements.requirement: Docker host tools receive the authoritative process host, executable resolver, environment policy, and workspace scope through composition.
requirements.acceptance: No direct new LocalWorkspaceProcessHost remains in plugin code.

requirements.requirement: Docker capability reports daemon/socket/context availability separately from executable presence.
requirements.acceptance: Linux socket permission, macOS desktop absence, remote DOCKER_HOST, and timeout states are tested without weakening policy.

requirements.requirement: The pinned FileTools desktop package has an explicit Windows/Linux/macOS compatibility report and test evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported or unverified OS capabilities are disabled truthfully; package upgrade/change is isolated.

requirements.requirement: Desktop open/reveal/preferred-application behavior is modeled as optional capabilities with host-bound executable preferences.
requirements.acceptance: Headless and service profiles never attempt desktop launch.

requirements.requirement: Every native/external plugin dependency has a version, probe, tested OS matrix, failure mode, and remediation entry.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown dependencies block support claims but not unrelated core startup.

requirements.requirement: Processes remains the owner of process-domain semantics, recovery, eligibility, evidence, and failure interpretation.
requirements.acceptance: No process-specific rule is moved into MAF Core, generic Infrastructure, or a global OS service.

requirements.requirement: Process strategies and special/domain drivers declare required host capabilities rather than branching directly on OS.
requirements.acceptance: Compilation/launch produces a deterministic missing-capability diagnostic before side effects.

requirements.requirement: ProcessDriverLayer.Platform is used only for process strategy composition that consumes declared host capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Architecture tests prevent filesystem/secrets/native process primitives from migrating into process drivers.

requirements.requirement: Runtime capability facts cannot grant project/workspace authority or override approvals/tool policy.
requirements.acceptance: Current canonical authority and per-run workspace ownership invariants remain green.

requirements.requirement: Process receipts/evidence serialize logical paths and platform capability facts without leaking host-sensitive absolute paths or secrets.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-OS golden fixtures and evidence policy tests pass.

requirements.requirement: Special tools/domain drivers have explicit behavior for unavailable terminal, shell, Docker, desktop, Python, Node, and MCP capabilities.
requirements.acceptance: Templates can be validated before a run and offer safe remediation or alternate strategy.

requirements.requirement: Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS run focused process-host, executable, environment, runtime-node, Manager, MCP, plugin, and process-driver tests.
requirements.acceptance: Actual-host gates are active and not replaced by mocked platform tests.

requirements.requirement: Workbench Playwright tests prove capability-aware actions and no PowerShell-only language on Unix/headless profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Evidence includes route, viewport, capability fixture, screenshots, and result.

requirements.requirement: Local stdio MCP and at least one governed external tool execute end-to-end on each claimed OS profile.
requirements.acceptance: Approval, secret binding, workspace containment, timeout, output, and cleanup invariants remain intact.

requirements.requirement: Manager launch/restart/recovery/termination tests prove no unrelated process is killed and no owned child is leaked.
requirements.acceptance: PID reuse, process exit race, unreadable metadata, watcher overflow, and shutdown interruption are injected.

requirements.requirement: A representative process using special tools completes or fails with the planned capability diagnostic on every target profile.
requirements.acceptance: Processes ownership, receipts, recovery, and host capability selection are reviewed independently.

requirements.requirement: Windows regression remains green and all runtime features can be disabled without blocking the core host.
requirements.acceptance: Runtime bundle closure cannot weaken the Core C4 evidence.

requirements.requirement: Final Gate R4 records supported profiles, known limitations, external dependency versions, rollback, and evidence paths.
requirements.acceptance: Only R4 may mark Unix portability implementation complete.
